newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize up in good volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize up in good volume.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed up in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Tuesday, with supply appearing after recent price rises, traders said.

FAS elevator maize closed up $1 at $104 for delivery to Buenos Aires, with exporters buying eagerly. Cash soybeans rose $2 for delivery to Rosario, with a shortage of supply as farmers wait for volatile markets to calm down. Rosario sunflower seed rose $3 to $222 in moderate volume, with crushers keen to buy.
